## Disabilities {.unnumbered}

Reasonable accommodation for persons with documented disabilities
should be established within the first two weeks of class
and arranged through the Disability Access Center:
telephone 360-650-3083; email <drsfrontdesk@wwu.edu>;
and on the web at [Disability Access Center](https://disability.wwu.edu/).

## Student Services {.unnumbered}

Western encourages students to seek assistance and support at the onset of an illness, difficulty, or crisis.

- In the case of a medical concern or question,
  please contact the Health Center: 360-650-3400,
  or visit [Student Health](https://studenthealth.wwu.edu/).
- In the case of an emotional or psychological concern or question,
  please contact the Counseling and Wellness Center: 360-650-3164,
  or visit [Counseling and Wellness Center](https://cwc.wwu.edu/).
- In the case of a health and safety concern,
  please contact the University Police: 360-650-3555,
  or visit [University Police](https://police.wwu.edu/).
- In the case of a family or personal crisis or emergency,
  please contact the [Dean of Students](https://www.wwu.edu/dean-students).
- To seek confidential support related to sexual violence,
  please contact CASAS (360-650-3700), the Student Health Center, and/or the Counseling and Wellness Center.
  To report sexual violence, please contact University Police, Bellingham Police,
  and/or the Title IX Coordinator
  in Western's [Civil Rights and Title IX Compliance](https://crtc.wwu.edu/) office (360-650-3307).
  Faculty are responsible employees who are required to report sex discrimination,
  including sexual violence that they learn about, to the Title IX Coordinator.

## Career Advising {.unnumbered}

I am glad to meet with you to discuss your short-, medium-, and long-term career goals.
[Academic Advising & Career Readiness](https://aacr.wwu.edu/) is also available
for help with academic planning or your career,
such as finding jobs and internships or getting feedback on your resume.

## Other Policies {.unnumbered}

Please read [Syllabi\@WWU](https://syllabi.wwu.edu/) for additional, important policies,
including accommodations, equal opportunity, the medical excuse policy,
ethical use of WWU computing resources, and the student conduct code.

## Start-of-Quarter Survey {.unnumbered}

Please fill out the anonymous [start-of-quarter survey](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeR4g368PE_HCeyF2IVcyVmSFBxhTfrTP69BX8ZCSfB6_R80A/viewform)
before class on Friday, January 8.
Every question is optional.
A few more optional questions need your name, so they are not on the form;
answer them in a Canvas message to me instead.

## Anonymous Feedback {.unnumbered}

Unlike the start-of-quarter survey,
the [anonymous feedback form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdGo-31iMGMyFMAMxgwGkPVa2mK4vK8lGEBN6fxCGwuZcfV-w/viewform)
stays open all quarter,
so you can use it at any time.
Tell me what is working, what is not,
and how I could improve the course.
I read every response.
